errors.evidence: The description introduces the list of y-axis categories with "including for example" ("включващ например") but then proceeds to list all 13 categories verbatim. This is excessively long and makes the paragraph difficult to read.

The description states the value is "26,0" for one of the segments in the category "Продължителността на годишния отпуск" (Duration of annual leave). However, the chart displays this value as the integer "26" without a decimal part.
